title: CaPolice Settings
description: Configuration file for CaPolice conditional access policy management.

$schema.description: Schema version of this settings file.

tenantId.description: The Entra ID tenant ID that the policies are managed in.

breakglassUsers.description: One or more break-glass user object IDs that are excluded from all conditional access policies.

breakglassGroups.description: One or more break-glass group object IDs that are excluded from all conditional access policies.

policies.description: Map of policies managed by CaPolice. Each key is an arbitrary identifier for the policy.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: A single conditional access policy entry.

file.description: Path to the JSON file containing the policy definition, relative to the settings file.

id.description: Object ID of the policy in the tenant. Omit when the policy has not yet been created.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the policy.

description.description: Optional description of what the policy enforces.

tag.description: Short tag used to group related policies, e.g. the prefix used in the naming convention.

version.description: Version of the policy in vX.Y format, or an empty string when not versioned.

skipBreakglass.description: When true, the break-glass users and groups are NOT automatically excluded from this policy.

status.description: Desired enforcement state of the policy.

includeUsers.description: Overrides conditions.users.includeUsers in the policy JSON at publish time. Values prefixed with ORG_ are placeholders from a source tenant and must be replaced before publishing.

excludeUsers.description: Overrides conditions.users.excludeUsers in the policy JSON at publish time. Values prefixed with ORG_ are placeholders from a source tenant and must be replaced before publishing.

includeGroups.description: Overrides conditions.users.includeGroups in the policy JSON at publish time. Values prefixed with ORG_ are placeholders from a source tenant and must be replaced before publishing.

excludeGroups.description: Overrides conditions.users.excludeGroups in the policy JSON at publish time. Values prefixed with ORG_ are placeholders from a source tenant and must be replaced before publishing.
